voidability.def: Damage or final blows from your Void abilities (grenade, melee, super, aspect abilities). Several Void pieces key off it, and Volatile explosions count as it.
voidability.q: Hitting a target with a Void ability or Volatile explosion makes them volatile.

truesight.def: A short buff that highlights nearby enemies through walls, granted alongside invisibility by Stylish Executioner.

disorient.def: Disoriented combatants lose track of you and struggle to attack. Applied by Snare Bomb and On the Prowl smoke and Unbreakable's shield and blast.
disorient.q: detonates into a disorienting smoke cloud

voidsmoke.def: A lingering Hunter smoke cloud that damages, weakens and disorients enemies inside it and makes allies who pass through invisible. It can trigger melee effects.
voidsmoke.q: Defeating priority targets creates a weakening cloud of smoke that makes you and allies invisible when passing through it.

prioritytarget.def: A combatant marked by On the Prowl. Defeating it releases a weakening smoke cloud and grants ability energy; Phantom Surge hits it harder.
prioritytarget.q: Periodically marks a nearby combatant as a priority target for you and your team.
